evidence: Before the fix, `uv run pytest tests/test_hooks_dropped_groups.py -q -p no:cacheprovider`: all 4 acceptances failed (3 R14 tests and 1 R5 test). After the fix, `uv run pytest tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_views.py tests/test_hooks_dropped_groups.py -q -p no:cacheprovider`: 57 passed. README Testing, four commands, all pass: canon 268 passed; tuner 134 passed; main suite 1461 passed; tmux 20 passed. Real-store probe (read-only) `printf '{"cwd":"/home/andrewyin/orchestra","session_id":"probe"}' | uv run orchestra hook-start --claude`: additionalContext length 7224, within 9000. Only orchestra/views.py changed; no frozen test or .canon file edited; canon not called.
observations: The R14 acceptances failed because hook_handoff_sections filtered groups to live efforts; the needs-human finding with no effort sits in group "", so it vanished; the blocking continuity-question with a non-effort subject was dropped for the same reason. The R5 acceptance failed because live_efforts counted active score:position records, so an effort with a closed goal and an open position stayed live and its constraint stayed in the block. After the group filter was removed, one acceptance still failed: the omitted "Not shown" line named the empty group "" and not the item "orphan-risk"; a label step now turns an empty group name into the sorted, comma-joined subjects of its items. The orchestra handoff rendering path is untouched: _group_records and _group_lines are unchanged. Changes in orchestra/views.py: live_efforts uses only GOAL (active, not closed score:effort records); hook_handoff_sections keeps every HOOK_VIEW group, ordered live efforts with a position stamp (newest first), then live efforts without a stamp (alphabetical), then all other groups (alphabetical); new helper _group_subjects supports the label for empty-named groups; hook_constraints unchanged but follows the narrower live set.
root_cause: hook_handoff_sections dropped every group not named after a live effort, so effortless or off-slug needs-human and blocking items never reached the start hook or its omitted line. live_efforts also treated an active score:position as proof of a live effort, even when the effort's goal was closed or missing.
verdict: pass
